CBES GROUP With over 45 years experience, we have developed a reputation for delivering a range of work, from major projects (up to £1m) to smaller contract, on time and within budget. Our work ethos has attributed to the growth of good working relationships with our clients, and has lead to further recommendations as highly reliable, professional, and competent contractor. HOW WE CAN HELP We pride ourselves on being a professionally run, approachable company who are able to undertake any or all of our services for a client, providing you with a comprehensive “one-stop” shop, saving you time and money not having to manage multiple contractors. Our work ethos has attributed to the growth of good working relationships with our clients and has led to further recommendations as a highly reliable, professional and competent company. A significant number of our clients have been with us for over 30 years as building a strong relationship and delivering on time and on budget is our absolute priority. This is largely due to the knowledgeable and highly trained staff who have all of the necessary qualifications and accreditations to make sure we provide a top class service every time. NEW OFFICES Exciting News: We’ve opened a new office & warehouse in Wellington, Somerset This modern facility brings together streamlined office space and an optimised warehouse, supporting our long-term vision and enhancing our services across Somerset and Devon. Come visit us at Unit 14, Westpark Business Park, Wellington, Somerset TA21 9AD Our Clients The Highest Standards We are an approved NICEIC contractor, accredited with BSI Quality Management Systems and CHAS, Safe Contractor, CAS Elite common assessment scheme approved, SSIP safety scheme in procurement, FIRAS UKAS passive fire protection, LEEA lifting equipment engineering association and a government approved Electric Vehicle installer for workplace charging scheme. At CBES Group we are committed to the on-going training and improvement of our services and staff in all areas in which we operate and therefore feel that we offer market leading service and quality of workmanship. We also hold full employer liability, public liability and professional indemnity giving you the assurance that you need when selecting us as a contractor for your next project.
